name: Gata (Spain)
description: Divided by a red diagonal band inscribed MUY NOBLE · GATA · MUY LEAL from the upper hoist to the lower fly, yellow below with a brown cat and white above with a green cross of Alcántara.
history: Municipal flag of Gata; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
